reviews.name: Anthony
reviews.title: A Must-Get for Marvel Fans!
reviews.body: Lately, the Marvel Legends Maximum Series line has been getting some mixed feedback about their products. But after seeing how the Maximum Series version of Thor looked, I know that I had to get it! I love the details of the action figure: the changeable heads, faces, and hands. reviews.name: Damian Alvarez
reviews.title: THE GOD OF THUNDER
reviews.body: Overall great figure a bit pricey but overall the best Thor you’re going to find for what you get. His articulation is great and what you should expect for a big fella such as Thor and his accessories, sculpt, and wired cloth cap make it so much more worth it!

reviews.name: Chavely
reviews.title: Super cute and fun!
reviews.body: My child is obsessed with the new Toy Story 5 movie, so this 7-inch Forky was a must-have. Great quality and the size is perfect to play with it. reviews.body: Toddler nephew absolutely loved this toy—he specifically asked for it, which made it an easy gift choice.
